name: Blip
author: Yogesh Ojha
description: Selection-aware actions for Omarchy: decode, format, convert, paste back.

barWidget.description: Selection-aware actions: decode, format, convert, paste back. Click the icon for the control panel.

schema.label: Armed
schema.description: Off means Blip watches nothing. The switch in the Blip panel toggles the same setting.

schema.label: Show the bar
schema.description: Automatic shows the bar as soon as you select something. Keybind only waits until you ask for it.

schema.label: Take the keyboard right away
schema.description: Off means the bar answers Escape and its action letters without taking focus, so everything else you type still reaches the window you selected in. On means it takes the keyboard outright, adding arrows and Tab.

schema.label: Search with
schema.description: Which engine the Search action opens. Custom uses the url below.

schema.label: Custom search url
schema.description: Where Custom sends the selection. Put %s where the selection goes, as in https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=code. Blip's own ${enc} works too, alongside ${text} and ${type}.

schema.label: Where it appears
schema.description: At the cursor puts the bar just above the pointer, flipping below it near the top of the screen.

schema.label: Fade after (seconds)
schema.description: How long the bar stays up before it fades. Hovering it or taking the keyboard holds it open.

schema.label: Shortest selection
schema.description: Selections shorter than this are ignored, so a stray double-click does not show the bar.

schema.label: Longest selection
schema.description: Selections longer than this are ignored.

schema.label: Actions on the bar
schema.description: The rest go behind the overflow key.

schema.label: Settle time (ms)
schema.description: How long a selection has to hold still before the bar appears.

schema.label: Allow actions that leave this machine
schema.description: Off hides every action marked network. On still asks before the first send, once per action.

schema.label: Disarm while sharing the screen
schema.description: No bar appears over a screen share or a recording.

schema.label: Never watch these apps
schema.description: Comma-separated. Matched against the focused window class and title.

schema.label: Show the bar icon
schema.description: Off hides the icon and keeps Blip running. Disarm with the keybind instead.

schema.label: Disabled actions
schema.description: Comma-separated action ids switched off in the Blip panel.
